title: Megurine Luka — Happy Anniversary! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Some weeks before Luka's anniversary
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that everyone's listened to the demo, shall we head back?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I've got a bunch of ideas now, so I can't wait to get started on the music video.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, then let's get to work. Thanks for today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's okay. See you—

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hold on a moment.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, I'm sure you're aware my anniversary is soon. I have a request.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? That's kind of rare for you, Luka. Is there something you'd like?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suppose you could say that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I was wondering if you could bring a whole cake and a candle for each person.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A whole cake? So not a bunch of slices like usual? It'd be easier to get a variety of flavors that way, though...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's right. I find that it would feel more like a proper celebration if we all ate from the same cake.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. Okay.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In that case, we better choose carefully to put a smile on Luka's face! Be sure to look forward to it♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I will. Please don't forget the candles as well.
Luka's Anniversary

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Do we have everything for the party?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! All that's left is to put the cake out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow... It looks so yummy...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The cream is pink.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Apparently it's berry-flavored. I thought it'd match Luka's look.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, what a wonderful color.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I also brought the candles. Did you want to put them on the cake, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, may I? Then, don't mind if I do.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Speaking of which, why does it need to be one candle per person?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's usually supposed to be the same as your age, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Done. How does this look?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nice. Looks good. Okay, I'll light them up—

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait. Before you do that... I have another request.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Another request?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I would like each person to light each candle as they wish me a happy anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Light each candle as they give you their well-wishes?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Is this some sort of ritual?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It would feel more ritualistic to blow them out one by one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The details aren't important! Anyway, what's with the sudden request?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki told me about this the other day... The me in your world gets wished a happy anniversary from her friends on the day of, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I would like to experience the same thing with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why you asked for a candle for each person...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, I think that's doable...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It'll be a little embarrassing to have you looking at us the whole time, though.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I mean an anniversary is a special occasion, so we can't really refuse...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, who would like to go first?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If no one wants to, then I'll go.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Happy anniversary. Hope you have a good one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, even MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, I'll go next. Happy anniversary, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is that not just a repeat of Mafuyu's? Would you change it up a bit?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um... Eat lots of cake.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you. I'll be sure to enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on, is this going to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Get harder to come up with something different the longer we wait? Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: W-When should I go...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess the earlier the better, right? I'll go next—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, wait, hold up. You can't just slide in like that. Let's play fair and do rock, paper, scissors!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Was this what Luka wanted?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Who knows.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, let us now recommence!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: First up is... Ena, because somehow she managed to win. All yours!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This doesn't sound very celebratory now.
*Sigh* Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka. It's a special day, after all, so make sure to enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... Happy anniversary, Luka. Um... Let's have a fun time today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka. Your opinions help me a lot. Thank you for everything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka. I'll do my best to make this a party to remember.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, last up is me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka! To express my gratitude, let's have an amazing time today♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's a shame that KAITO wasn't here to give me his well-wishes, but I'll be sure to ask the next time I find him.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sounds good. Alright, ready to blow out the candles?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. Here we go. Happy anniversary, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Blow*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks to all of you, this will be an anniversary to remember.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, why don't we have some cake? I can't wait to see what kind of party today will turn out to be.
